COD.note: Mosolo is named but the document does not say the BCC runs or oversees it in service.
Fee and rate disclosure are proposals only; no rule or complaints body stated.
No cross-border corridor stated; Bakong is Cambodia's.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The article states BCC Instruction n°58 of 4 September 2024 provides for interoperability of banks, microfinance institutions, fintechs and e-money institutions and their connection to the national switch Mosolo.
The CEGFT, a Congolese centre on financial governance and transparency, published six proposals on implementing BCC Instruction n°58 on payment interoperability.

COD.note: Interoperability and Mosolo connection are described as provided for and proposed, not as in service.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
